subject: prd/worker-transcript-metrics
statement: This feature produces usage figures; the routed plane consumes them by reference. The routed plane owns route selection and launch fidelity — which native profile was chosen, and whether the process launched with it. This feature owns per-process transcript metrics, usage figures included. Where `prd:planner-driven-model-routing` FR-20 connects "available usage measurements" to a routing decision, those measurements are this feature's records, referenced by identity rather than restated: FR-20 positions itself as a consumer of whatever usage is available, not as a second producer of it. No requirement of this contract changes, and none is ceded.
